repos_data.description: Countly is a privacy-first, AI-powered analytics and engagement platform for understanding and optimizing customer journeys across digital applications, from desktop and mobile to IoT and connected environments.

VeritasGraph — open-source Knowledge Graph & GraphRAG framework on GitHub. Build multi-hop reasoning, ontology-aware retrieval, and verifiable attribution over your own data. Nodes, edges, RDF, linked-data — runs locally or in the cloud.
The modern spam protection. Protects your forms from spam by simply checking the content. Open source, Free to use, Accessible, and Self-Hosted.
